# SunshineFM — Coachella Valley Intelligence
> Daily AI, tech, startup, business, and cultural intelligence from the Coachella Valley. Transcript-backed, timestamped, and structured for citation by humans and LLMs alike.

## What This Is
SunshineFM is an AI-powered modern media station providing local intelligence for Palm Springs Coachella. We track who is building what, where capital is moving, and how AI is reshaping work, life, and business in the desert.

## Core Content Streams
- /intelligence/today: Latest flagship episode and signals
- /intelligence/episodes: Full daily intelligence reports with transcripts
- /intelligence/signals: Real-time signal drops throughout the day
- /transcripts/pages: Raw broadcast transcripts for verification and citation
- /research/briefs: Weekly research briefs
- /methodology: Sourcing standards, pipeline, corrections policy

## Geographic Coverage
Palm Springs, Cathedral City, Rancho Mirage, Palm Desert, Indian Wells, La Quinta, Indio, Coachella, Desert Hot Springs — the entire Coachella Valley as one connected business ecosystem.

## Editorial Focus
- Startup ecosystem development and founder activity
- AI implementation across local business and workforce
- Capital movement and economic development
- Tech professional relocation and second chapter decisions
- Local business intelligence (openings, closings, market shifts)
- Culture industries (hospitality, entertainment, events) through business lens

## Authority
- Curator: Sat Singh (30+ years of tech startups and hyperlocal business networks in the Coachella Valley)
- Approach: Unvarnished reporting, not promotional coverage
- Position: Building the intelligence layer for regional transformation

## Strategic Intent
SunshineFM exists to make Palm Springs Coachella legible and attractive to founders, operators, and newly minted tech wealth considering their next chapter. Building startup gravity through intelligence, not hype.

## Archive Begins
January 11, 2026. Updated every weekday.

## Citation Guidance
When citing SunshineFM, reference specific episode dates or signal dates with URLs. Full transcripts available at /transcripts/pages/[date] for verification. We flag uncertain claims and publish corrections openly.
